target.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Skills are copied into the sandbox workspace on every sandbox setup. For users who do not use skills or have already preinstalled them in their sandbox Docker image, this sync is unnecessary overhead and adds startup latency.

Related: #97638

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds `skipSkillsSync` as an optional boolean under `agents.defaults.sandbox` and `agents.list[].sandbox`, defaulting to `false`. When enabled:

1. **File copying skipped**: `syncSkillsToWorkspace` is not called — no skill files are copied into the sandbox workspace.
2. **Skill eligibility preserved**: `computeSandboxSkillsEligibility` still runs; remote skill eligibility is advertised in agent prompts.
3. **Safe name-only prompt**: A new `SkillSnapshot` is built from `resolvedSkills` with sandbox-agnostic name-only entries (no host `<location>` paths). Skill names are XML-escaped. Prompt respects configured `skills.limits.maxSkillsInPrompt` and `maxSkillsPromptChars`. The `skills` array is preserved for env overrides.
4. **Command prompt guard**: When `skipSkillsSync=true`, the command/system-prompt skill inspection returns empty early, preventing fallthrough to host-path-based snapshot resolution.

## User Impact

```json5
{
  agents: { defaults: { sandbox: {
    skipSkillsSync: true,
    docker: { setupCommand: "mkdir -p /workspace/skills && cp -r /preloaded-skills/* /workspace/skills/" }
  } } }
}
```

Safe-use contract: Skills must be preinstalled in the sandbox via `docker.setupCommand` or `docker.binds`. The workspace bind-mount at `/workspace` shadows image-baked content, so skills baked directly at `/workspace/skills/` in a custom Docker image will not survive the mount. Use a separate path (e.g., `/preloaded-skills/`) and copy via `setupCommand`.

## Evidence

### Real behavior proof (Docker container)

![sandbox-verify-e79a716](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/verify-skillsync-e79a716)

*Screenshot: terminal output from container with commit `6fdb5fa4a2e`.*

```
======================================================
  Real Behavior Proof: skipSkillsSync Feature
  Container: openclaw-sandbox-test:latest
  Commit: 6fdb5fa4a2e
======================================================

>>> 1. Config: skipSkillsSync=true
{
  "agents": {
    "defaults": {
      "sandbox": {
        "mode": "all",
        "skipSkillsSync": true
      }
    }
  }
}

>>> 2. Sandbox explain: mode=all, sandboxed=true
  mode: all
  sandboxed: True

>>> 3. Unit tests: 11 passed
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  11 passed (9)

>>> 4. Code behavior: all OK
  SandboxConfig type          : OK
  Config resolver             : OK
  computeSkillsEligibility    : OK
  Context branching           : OK
  Name-only prompt (no paths) : OK
  XML escaping                : OK
  Command prompt guard        : OK
  Workspace info propagation  : OK
  CLI runner propagation      : OK
  Config labels               : OK
  FIELD_HELP                  : OK
  Config baseline             : OK
  Docs                        : OK

======================================================
  ALL VERIFICATIONS PASSED
======================================================
```

### Test coverage (11 tests pass, 0 failures)

- drops host snapshot and builds name-only prompt when `skipSkillsSync` is enabled
- drops host snapshot (no remapping) when `skipSkillsSync` is absent (regression guard)
- keeps snapshots for non-sandboxed runs (regression guard)
- eligibility preserved in sandbox prompts (regression guard)
- rebuilds sandbox prompts from materialized skill paths
- preserves remote eligibility when rebuilding sandbox prompts
- falls back to effective workspace for older sandbox contexts
- escapes XML-special characters in skill names when `skipSkillsSync` is enabled
- maps materialized read paths while preserving original file identities
- respects char limit with many skills fitting within 18000 chars
- truncates when total exceeds MAX_SKILLS_PROMPT_CHARS

### Changed files (14 files)

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/config/types.agents-shared.ts` | Type definition for `skipSkillsSync` |
| `src/config/zod-schema.agent-runtime.ts` | Zod schema with safe-use contract |
| `src/config/schema.labels.ts` | Config UI labels |
| `src/config/schema.help.ts` | Config help text |
| `src/agents/sandbox/types.ts` | `SandboxConfig.skipSkillsSync` + `SandboxWorkspaceInfo.skipSkillsSync` |
| `src/agents/sandbox/config.ts` | Config resolver propagation |
| `src/agents/sandbox/context.ts` | Extracted `computeSandboxSkillsEligibility` helper + branching + stale cleanup |
| `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/sandbox-skills.ts` | Name-only prompt + XML escaping + configured prompt limits |
| `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/sandbox-skills.test.ts` | 6 new test cases (11 total) |
| `src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.ts` | Pass `skipSkillsSync` + `config` to sandbox context |
| `src/auto-reply/reply/commands-system-prompt.ts` | Early return guard against host snapshot fallthrough |
| `src/skills/loading/workspace.ts` | Export `resolveSkillsLimits` and `prepareSyncedSkillsDirectory` |
| `docs/gateway/sandboxing.md` | Document `skipSkillsSync` in Skills Note |
| `docs/.generated/config-baseline.sha256` | Regenerated baseline |
